query: For every new incoming email in our events inbox, run an AI extraction with these variables: client_email (the external sender/client email address), event_date (latest confirmed date, YYYY-MM-DD), event_start_time (latest confirmed start time), event_summary (concise summary: event type, location, catering/food needs, AV requirements, status, special requests), and number_of_attendees (numeric only). Then add a note laying out each value: client email, event date, event start time, summary, number of attendees.

Extract two things from each new incoming email with AI: invoice_id (the invoice identifier as written; empty string if missing) and product_name (as written; empty string if missing). If either variable is present, add a note 'inv: {{invoice_id}}' / 'name: {{product_name}}' and set the status to Pending.

Use AI to detect when an incoming email explicitly asks for an invoice copy or an account statement (also have it label the request_type as invoice, statement, or both). When it's such a request, tag the conversation 'Invoice/Statement Request'.

For incoming job applications: have AI detect whether the email is a candidate application, and also draft a concise professional reply. When it is one, pin a note that says 'Suggested reply for candidate email:' followed by the drafted reply.

Use AI to spot emails clearly about billing or payments and to write a short internal summary. When an email is billing-related: tag it 'Billing', pin a note 'Billing summary: {{email_summary}}', and assign the conversation to Arjun.
On replies we receive from contacts (not new conversations), have AI check whether the email is about HTS codes, country of origin, or dimensions. If it is, tag the conversation 'HTS/COO'.

Build a 'Thank You Closer': when any new incoming email arrives on a conversation whose status is already Closed, use AI to determine whether it's purely a thank-you/closure acknowledgment (only thanks, pleasantries, resolution confirmation, or sign-off — ignoring signatures and quoted text) and to list any actionable reasons found (questions, new issues, follow-ups, complaints, reference numbers, attachment mentions). If it's an acknowledgment AND no actionable reasons were found, set the status back to Closed and pin a note 'Email thread closed by Thank You Closer'.

Thank-you detector: on replies from contacts where the conversation is already Closed, use AI to judge (a) whether the email is only a closure acknowledgment and (b) whether it has any actionable content (questions, requests, complaints, unresolved issues, attachments, reference IDs). If it's an acknowledgment AND has no actionable content, keep it Closed and pin a note 'Email thread closed by AI Task'.

On replies from contacts arriving on already-Closed conversations, run our AI thank-you detector (is it a closure acknowledgment? does it contain actionable content? also extract the actionable phrases and count the messages in the thread). When the acknowledgment check is true and the actionable-content check is true, close the conversation and pin a note 'Email thread closed by AI Task'.

For replies from contacts: use AI to detect out-of-office auto-replies and whether the stated return date is within 30 days (either signal in the first check), and additionally only during these date windows (America/Toronto): Aug 1-3, Sep 1-3, Oct 1-3, Nov 1-3, or Dec 1-3, 2026. When matched, tag the conversation 'OOO' and close it.

Have AI check each new incoming email for an order ID (patterns like ORD-XXXXX, #XXXXX, ORDER-XXXXX) and extract the exact string (or NO_ORDER_ID if absent). When an order ID is present, write it into our 'Order ID' text custom field.

query: For support-ticket emails (subject contains '[Support Ticket'): have AI read the ticket, pull out the customer's email address (the value after 'Email' in the body; n/a if absent) and classify severity as Critical, High, Medium, Low, or Unknown. When severity is High or Critical: add the tags 'Support Ticket' and 'High Severity', and write the customer email into our 'Customer Email' text custom field.
Auto-close any new conversation whose subject contains 'Verona Group' — and double-check it with an AI variable that verifies the subject really contains that phrase before closing.

Spectrum billing emails (sender contains 'spectrum'): use AI to decide if it's a routine reminder or scheduled-payment notice (close it) versus a missed/failed/overdue payment or service-interruption warning (leave it alone), and to give a short reason. When it should be closed, close it and add a note 'Auto-closed Spectrum billing email. Reason: {{classification_reason}}'.
Cash App emails: if the sender contains 'cash app' or the email is addressed to jason.pay@veloce.example, and AI confirms the email really is from Cash App, assign the conversation to Jason.

Urgency triage: have AI label each new incoming email's urgency as CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW based on the latest meaningful content, plus an 8-15 word reason citing the main signal. When it's CRITICAL or HIGH, pin a note with the urgency level and reason, and send the team a notification (email notifications on).

Classify each incoming email's urgency with AI (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, based on language, tone, and deadlines), also noting whether it uses explicit urgent wording and a one-line reason. For CRITICAL or HIGH emails, pin a note with the urgency level and reason and send an in-app notification (no email).

Vendor remittance requests: have AI detect when a vendor explicitly asks for remittance advice, payment backup/references, ACH or wire details, or documentation to reconcile a payment (and separately, whether they're asking for payment status). When it's a remittance request: tag 'Remittance', unassign the conversation, send our remittance auto-reply, and tag 'Auto-replied'.
